paragraphs.text: Skule was a wizard from Golthonor , part of the Dominarian continent of Corondor , during the Time of Legends .

Skule was a mage from the City-State of Balthesa , who met Xarl as a young boy, and took him on as a spellsquire. They left Balthesa together, and years later, Xarl betrayed Skule to the warlord Mandek Ironfist . Threatening to kill Skule's family, Xarl forced the elder wizard to summon the Serra Angel Trine . For his part in the Enslavement of Trine , a 326-year-long period of terror on Corondor when thousands, if not millions, were slain, Skule was murdered by Xarl immediately after binding the angel.
